provenance.artwork: Original hand-authored vector artwork (this scene.svg), drawn for M3 WP3 as the draft set canteen_counter_m3; no AI-generated, raster or third-party sources.

provenance.styleAnchor: Accepted M1 B-direction (docs/ART_DIRECTION_M1.md) and figure/lin_b_draft palette: outline #424e46, muted teal #477c7b, cream #eadcbb, terracotta #b96a55, warm woods, flat fills with opacity overlays, no filters.
provenance.supportAgreement: Declared support counter y=400 equals the painted data-support-top=400 on counter_top_surface (top quad back edge y368, front edge y430, resting line y400); closes the M0/M2 declared-vs-painted defect class at the source.
provenance.materials: M4 layer passes (docs/ART_MATERIALS_M4.md), declared through the M3 set-layer seam: material_pigment = region palettes (each region its own light/shade pigment family, warm key glaze left, cool ambient fill right); material_detail = scale-keyed contours and detail recovery (small props restated at their own fine scale, near silhouettes weighted, far art thinned, speculars restored); material_paper = paper tooth keyed to the painted surface, 45-degree halftone in shade regions, dry-brush ink edges, paper reserve kept over the window glass; lighting_shade + lighting_key = one declared light model (source: the left window; key #f7e8c3, ambient fill #5f6a72, radial falloff around x330 y290 art units; shadows cast to the right/back, feathered as elliptical pools rather than polygonal mattes), composited above the actor plane so set and actors share the source; ink_contour = the final ink drawn above every wash (props' linework at its drawn weight, chalk/marker lines, the steamer's steam). One shared feathered matte (m4_prop_hold_off) holds the pigment, paper, shade and key washes off the ten drawn props with an elliptical alpha ramp, exactly zero inside each prop box and a quarter of the box wide outside it. All marks are static vector art; no filters, no raster, no per-actor projected shadow. Blending is the M4 declared-layer extension (blend/opacity).
